name: orbiagents-desktop
description: Local-first multi-agent command center and pixel office
author: SudarshanTechLabs

scripts.package:mac:dir: pnpm build && electron-builder --dir --mac --arm64 --publish never -c.forceCodeSigning=false -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false -c.mac.notarize=false && node scripts/verify-macos-package.mjs --allow-unsigned --app-only
scripts.package:mac:unsigned: pnpm build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never -c.forceCodeSigning=false -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false -c.mac.notarize=false && node scripts/verify-macos-package.mjs --allow-unsigned
scripts.package:mac:release: node scripts/check-macos-release-readiness.mjs && pnpm build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-macos-package.mjs --require-release-signature
